data.text: Luke, you’re being offered an equal place here, not asked to step aside for the locals. Ten tons each is the largest equal monthly catch we can keep taking while restoring the lake to 100 tons. My family’s livelihood—and yours, if you stay—depends on leaving those breeding fish. I support keeping our nets ashore while we agree, then landing smaller loads together so we can track the total before it’s too late. If your concern is that someone else will take more, let’s address that directly. Would fishing together with a shared tally give you enough confidence to accept 10 tons?
